text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While training with Rice Shower on the ramped track…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We notice Mihono Bourbon silently running along the same course.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her speed and strength are incredible, just like when she's in a real race.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Warm-up complete. Checking vital signs… No abnormalities detected.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: W-wow… She barely broke a sweat even after running like that…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower might be able to learn something from Mihono Bourbon's running style.
choice_data_list: How about we go ask about her training regimen?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh? A-are we allowed to do that?
choice_data_list: Sure, think of it as another part of training.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: …R-right. I do want to run like that, after all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower collects herself and goes to speak to Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-you were incredible back there… Do you always run like that?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: That was merely a warm-up. Today's primary training begins now.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: A w-warm-up?! You were just getting started?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Commencing weighted ramp training preparation. Attaching weights to designated areas…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon suddenly begins attaching massive weight to her ankles!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You're going to run the ramped track with weights?! Aren't they heavy?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: They are.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah… I-I suppose that was obvious…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: However, according to my calculations, this amount of resistance is necessary for the most effective training.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: If you would like, you may use the weights over there.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Returning to primary objective. Confirming course conditions… Conditions favorable. Commencing final weight adjustments.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She adds a few more weights before taking off.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: W-wow! She's going just as fast as before!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: O-okay… Maybe I should try it too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But it looks way too heavy…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: What should I do?
choice_data_list: Challenge yourself as best you can!
Why not just observe Mihono Bourbon some more?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: What should I do?
choice_data_list: Challenge yourself as best you can!
Why not just observe Mihono Bourbon some more?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-you're right! I'm going to challenge myself!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Maybe I'll just try one… to start.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She tries to pick up one of the weights…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-it's heavier than I thought!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-but… I am challenging myself, after all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She puts on the heaviest weights she can still run with and takes on the ramped track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks as exhausting as one would expect, but it seems like her hard work is going to pay off.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-you're right. Maybe she has some kind of secret technique.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Watch and learn… Watch and learn… I must watch Mihono Bourbon and learn all that I can.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Stare…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She observes Mihono Bourbon's vigorous run intently.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Aha! M-maybe…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like she's learned something from observing Mihono Bourbon's practice up close.
